<details>
The script `update-pkgver.sh` is a maintainer helper script designed to automate updating the package version (`pkgver`) and associated metadata in the PKGBUILD file based on the latest or specified GitHub release of the WebKVM project. It retrieves the latest release tag from `https://github.com/Slaker19/webkvm/releases/latest` using a HEAD request, extracts the tag name, validates it with a regex to ensure it follows a version-like format (e.g., `0.2.0` or `v0.1.8-fix01`), and then fetches the corresponding `SHA256SUMS` file to extract the checksum for the source tarball.

The script updates the `_tag`, `pkgver`, `pkgrel`, and `sha256sums` fields in the PKGBUILD, then runs `makepkg -fC --nodeps` to download and verify the source tarball, run build preparations, and package the result without installing dependencies. If the build fails, it safely rolls back to the original PKGBUILD. It concludes by regenerating `.SRCINFO` and printing instructions. All network operations are directed solely at the project's official GitHub repository, and the script performs proper validation of the tag format and checksum. The actions are consistent with standard AUR maintainer workflows and pose no evidence of malicious behavior.
</details>
